items.stem: During a readiness review of an AI-generated service, the tests are green. What is the right conclusion?

options.text: Green tests are necessary but not sufficient; confirm the tests meaningfully exercise the behaviour
options.rationale: Correct: AI-generated tests can be shallow or tautological, so their coverage must be reviewed.

options.text: Green tests prove the service is production-ready
options.rationale: Passing tests alone do not establish readiness.

options.text: Green tests mean security review can be skipped
options.rationale: Security review is independent of unit-test status.

options.text: Green tests remove the need for a rollback plan
options.rationale: Rollback planning is always required for production.

items.explanation: Correct: AI-generated tests can be shallow or tautological, so their coverage must be reviewed.

items.stem: Which TWO issues are especially important to check in AI-generated code? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Calls to hallucinated or non-existent APIs and libraries
options.rationale: Correct: models can invent plausible-looking but non-existent APIs.
Correct: generated code may pull in dependencies with incompatible licences.

options.text: Whether the code uses the newest syntax available
options.rationale: Syntax novelty is not a readiness criterion.

options.text: Whether the prompt that produced it was long
options.rationale: Prompt length says nothing about code safety or correctness.

items.explanation: Correct: models can invent plausible-looking but non-existent APIs.

items.stem: What must a production-readiness sign-off include for an AI-generated application?

options.text: A named human owner accountable for the service and a tested rollback plan
options.rationale: Correct: clear accountability and a rollback path are essential for sign-off.

options.text: A statement that the AI tool is responsible for the code
options.rationale: Accountability cannot be assigned to a tool.

options.text: Only a screenshot of the app running
options.rationale: A screenshot is not evidence of readiness.

options.text: A promise to add tests later
options.rationale: Deferring tests undermines the readiness review.

items.explanation: Correct: clear accountability and a rollback path are essential for sign-off.
